title: Approval Call Webhook: a failed call is not retried and not logged

panels.caption: Approval webhook: one attempt, no retry, no record of the failure
Expected: the same delivery handling as TAVI workflow webhooks
text: TAVI workflow webhooks retry a failed call (about +30 s, +2.5 min, +10 min) and log every attempt with its status and error in the rule execution.
The approval Call Webhook uses the same action shape (type Webhook, url, method, body, headers, timeout), so the same retries and the same log are expected.
Without a log an admin cannot see that the call after approval failed.
sources: Observed on staging-crm, cases WH-04 and WH-16, 25 Oct 2026

notes: Receiver: a fresh webhook.site URL set to answer 500.
Related: NDC-2539 (owner empty in approval webhooks).
